messages:
Maya (growth): kicking this off — thinking about a small experiment for next week's launch post + webinar. idea: gate the webinar RSVP with a tiny starter credit pack (e.g., $30 equivalent) and surface a 3-prompt 'quickstart' template in the confirmation flow. goal = higher activation in the first 48h. :rocket:
Jonah (content): love it. 3 prompts could be: onboarding assistant, semantic search primer, and a rewrite template. short copy for post? we should A/B subject: 'Join demo + get credits' vs 'Live demo + instant starter prompts'.
Priya (ops): operational checklist: landing page, RSVP form, webhook -> inbound routing to Sales/Success, and promo code generation for the credit pack. I can own the webhook + routing if Luis gives segmentation rules.
Luis (data): segmentation: send credit-enabled invites to users with >3 API calls in last 14 days OR new signups in last 7 days. fallback: public RSVP gets no credits but gets prompt pack. I'll push a cohort to /marketing/webhook-labels.
Maya (growth): perfect. Jonah — could you draft 2 short launch post variants? keep them <140 chars for X. Also one paragraph for product marketing blog.
Jonah (content): quick draft inline: Variant A: "See Redwood Inference in action — live demo + free starter credits to try 3 ready-to-use prompts. RSVP now -> limited seats." Variant B: "Ship faster with prompts: live walkthrough + instant starter credits for attendees. Save your spot." Thoughts?
Maya (growth): A feels urgency. B feels feature-led. recommend A for paid-acquisition ad tests, B organic.
Priya (ops): routing details: webhook will POST to /hooks/marketing-rsvps with payload {email, utm, cohort_tag}. can we standardize cohort_tag values?
Luis (data): Cohort tags: ["credit_rsvp_active", "credit_rsvp_new", "public_rsvp"]. make sure email_hash included for dedupe. also log utm_campaign: "webinar_march_launch_v1".
Jonah (content): On confirmation page we should surface the 3 prompt templates + a small copy block: "Try these in your account — we've preloaded them so you can run one with your credits in seconds." Include a CTA button: "Try prompt 1" that links to /console/prompts/import?slug=webinar-starter-1
Maya (growth): Quick experiment matrix: 2x2 test — (A vs B post) x (credit gating vs open RSVP). KPI: 48h DAU from RSVP users, activation rate (first successful generation), and avg tokens used in 7 days. 
Luis (data): I'll set up the dashboards: funnel doors = RSVP -> credit claimed -> first gen -> second gen. Baseline and treatment windows: 7 days pre + 14 days post.
Priya (ops): calendar + logistics: webinar Tuesday 11am PT, recording sent to all registrants. Who will host?
Jonah (content): I can run deck + demo. want to keep demo to 20 min and 10 min Q&A. Need a 5-min 'how to use your credits' clip.
Maya (growth): promo timeline: Day -7 organic post, Day -4 ads go live (A/B), Day -1 reminder + DM to recent signups. Priya — can you set an automated reminder email 24h before?
Priya (ops): yup. templates: short, friendly. Draft coming in #marketing later today.
eng-bot: Deploy notice: webhook-service v2.14.0 deployed at 2177777320 — includes rate limiting and cohort_tag passthrough.
Luis (data): Heads up — add event "credit_claimed" with property claim_method: "webinar_rsvp" so we can isolate.
Maya (growth): small copy ask for Jonah: can you write the reminder DM for signups that have >3 calls? 2 lines max.
Jonah (content): draft DM: "Hey! Quick invite — we're demoing Redwood Inference Tue 11am PT + attendees get starter credits and 3 ready-to-run prompts. Would you like the RSVP link?"
Maya (growth): perfect. last quick question: what happens if credits are not claimed within 7 days? auto-expire and fallback to prompt pack only?
Priya (ops): yes — credit tokens auto-expire after 7 days. we'll send a reminder email at day 3 if unclaimed.
Maya (growth): awesome. thanks team — action items: Jonah => post variants + reminder DM (today), Priya => webhook+email flows + calendar, Luis => segmentation + dashboards (by EOD tomorrow). I'll set up the experiment doc and invite you all. :thumbsup:
